question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Retreat
solution:
The correct answer is "**Advance**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Retreat** means **to withdraw** or to go backward. 

 
 
• **Example**: *Harry **withdrew** his name from the competition.*
 
 
 
• **Advance** means **to move forward** or to develop.
 
 
• **Example**: *I have **advanced** my knowledge in Spanish.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, the antonym of Retreat is Advance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Strengthen** - to become stronger.

 
 
• **Example:** *Louis **strengthened** his coding skills.*
 
 
 
• **Promote** - to go higher.
 
 
• **Example:** *I was **promoted** to the Manager of my division.*
 
 
 
• **Push** - to move something forward using force.
 
 
• **Example**: *Harvey **pushed** Mark into the swimming pool. *
